data.gender_notes: Indivar is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Indivar means 'Blue Lotus' in Sanskrit and Hindi. It symbolizes divine beauty and spiritual growth. The name Indivar carries the meaning “Blue Lotus” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Indivar usually hope their child will grow to embody blue lotus and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Indivar was a renowned poet and philosopher in medieval India, who lived during the 13th century. He was a disciple of the philosopher-poet, Jñāneśvara, and is known for his devotional poems in Marathi language, particularly in the genre of Bhakti poetry, which emphasizes the love and devotion towards God.

Indivar, also known as Indura, was a Jain Tirthankara, a spiritual teacher and leader, who lived around the 9th or 10th century BCE. He is believed to have been the 23rd Tirthankara in the present cycle of existence, according to Jaina tradition.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Indivar' is of Hindu origin and translates to 'man of the indus'. In modern context, this name is often associated with individuals who are making a mark in the fields of technology, entrepreneurship and inspiration. Indivars can be found sharing their experiences, ideas and insights on various platforms like LinkedIn, Medium and Quora. LinkedIn, being a professional networking site, is a popular choice for Indivars to showcase their work experiences and establish a professional network. Medium, on the other hand, is a go-to platform for Indivars to publish their articles and thoughts on various topics. Quora, with its vast knowledge base and diverse community, provides an excellent opportunity for Indivars to engage in meaningful discussions on various topics and share their knowledge and expertise.
